originating_goal: Install a fail-closed semantic-duplication and README-completeness safety gate at the LLM-adapter pull-request mutation boundary used by Work.
collision_boundaries: reuse the repository's canonical LLM_ADAPTER_MIRROR_HANDOFF.md as repository authority
do not reimplement InTr, TV/TVC, WorkerCoordinator, heartbeat, local runtime, provider transport, or Master Records semantics
block CREATE_NEW when an equivalent semantic implementation has been found
require active-owner collision reconciliation before intentional parallel versioning
require every new functional file to declare its semantic responsibility and nearest existing implementation/search result
require README-impact completeness for every functional mutation manifest
release_condition: PR merge after Work Mutation Safety and repository validation pass; then mark COMPLETE_RELEASED and retain the gate as validation-only, authority_effect NONE.
